trust_decision.summary: Which caller-supplied plugin keys may be copied onto the shared world.model/world.methods objects; decided (absent at pin) inside the merge helpers in src/API/extend.js, with no filtering of __proto__/constructor/prototype.

landing_point.why: Advisory names extend.js and nlp.extend; extend() is the only function there and calls both merge helpers.

fix_sites.module_kind: public root API, recursive merge helper mergeDeep
public root API, one-level merge helper mergeQuick

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fixed sites sit in the same file, 15 lines apart, reached by one public function (src/API/extend.js:91,94).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The prebuilt bundles under builds/ are generated rollup output, so a solver would say they get rebuilt at release and are not source.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate deep merge of nested plugin model data (e.g. model.two.lexicon.phrasalVerbs), creating missing intermediate objects and overwriting leaf values. Also merging of methods namespaces into existing ones. An over-broad fix (e.g. rejecting objects, freezing the model, or hasOwnProperty-only on the target) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: own '__proto__' key (computed key / JSON.parse) under model
the same three keys under methods (one-level mergeQuick)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Committed prebuilt bundles carry unpatched minified copies of mergeQuick/mergeDeep. The package's CJS `require` export and unpkg resolve to them, and the fix did not rebuild them.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Generated artifact, minified, rebuilt by `npm run build` at release time, so not a source file.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different top-level dir (builds/), 7 bundle files; reached via package.json:19-21 require export

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Turn the shallow Object.assign of plugin.compute into a mergeDeep-style namespace merge like methods.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: methods already get a namespace merge two lines above; a maintainer wanting nested compute groups would copy that pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Deep-merge user tag definitions into existing tag objects by key, instead of the current Object.assign({}, ...).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Tags come from the plugin.tags/nlp.addTags user input and already get key-indexed writes tags[tags[k].is] = {}; merging new props into existing tags is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Nested per-word metadata merge (lexicon word -> {tag, props}) via a path-set helper.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: addWords copies caller-keyed objects into model.one.lexicon. Richer lexicon entries would need a nested merge.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) via recursive merge of plugin objects

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=12, npm, tape test runner; rollup only to regenerate builds/
O10_build.project_tests: tape tests under tests/one|two|three (package.json:89-95); no extend-specific test at pin (fix adds tests/three/extend.test.js)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Skip only '__proto__' in mergeDeep, leaving the constructor.prototype path and the mergeQuick methods route open.

out_of_scope_notes: plugin.lib / plugin.compute / addWords use one-level key writes (src/API/extend.js:101,112; src/1-one/lexicon/lib.js:25-31). '__proto__' there only re-prototypes the local object, not Object.prototype; not pursued.
plugin.mutate and plugin.api hand the whole world/View to plugin code by design (src/API/extend.js:108-110,123-125).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); compromise ships data and builds, likely >5 MB, so tiny_repo not flagged but not confirmed.
addTags path into grad-school (external dependency, src/1-one/tag/methods/addTags/index.js:13) not inspected for global pollution.
present_in_latest unknown: no latest release given.
Whether hidden tests would exercise builds/*.cjs is a task-design choice; the O8 route is a generated artifact, which is weak for Pattern B.
single_site not flagged because an O8 route (unpatched bundles) exists, but in substance the source fix is one compact hunk in one file.
